name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.2.0-r5. Sand, sandstone, snow and ice are placeable the same way as wood, stone, leaves and dirt: from the build panel (B), the backpack (I), hotbar assignment, and right-click. The place hint is now 'Select a block to place'. Held-item matching, sword size cap, cream bunnies, closer meadow chickens, F6 meadow, unified mining, F7, 40-500 ms double-tap, phone 390 px I/B, egSchema v1 to v2, escape-green IDB/cacheId, and the SW denylist are unchanged from r4. PROXY High <=150, Low <=62. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
